rows.title: The germinal products set's own consignment addresses page, its five party pickers and its overview task, with no county parish holding number and no permanent address
rows.detail: A trader importing germinal products needs to record every party of the consignment inside the germinal notification, on a page that reads and behaves like the one live animals use. Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are never pets, so the germinal set is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses: it shows no county parish holding number section and no permanent address section, and serves neither page. This gives the germinal products set its own consignment addresses page and its own five party pickers, under the germinal set's own journey and routes, copied from the live-animals page and pickers once they are built, so they carry the same Remove buttons and full-width pickers. Two hints differ: germinal products are not animals and are unloaded but not accommodated, so the place of origin and place of destination hints use germinal wording on the page and on their pickers. Its overview gets one Addresses section holding a single consignment addresses task that is complete as soon as the five addresses are given.
acceptanceCriteria: For every germinal commodity, a germinal products notification's consignment addresses page shows exactly five sections, in this order: "Place of origin", "Consignor", "Consignee", "Importer", "Place of destination". (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-141, prototype-dr2-1-source-p9-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018, -p1-057)

Every link and button on a germinal products notification's pages opens one of that set's own steps, and none of them opens a county parish holding number page or a permanent address page; opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows "Page not found". (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-017, -p1-018, -p1-025; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-048, -p2-057, -p2-098, -p2-106; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-059, repo-frontend-p14-061)

The germinal consignment addresses page shows the caption "Addresses", the heading "Consignment addresses" and the intro "Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment." (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-001; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-010)

On the germinal consignment addresses page and on its place of origin picker, the place of origin hint reads "The address where the consignment begins its journey to Great Britain". (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-142; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-057)

On the germinal consignment addresses page and on its place of destination picker, the place of destination hint reads "This is where the consignment will be unloaded. If a health certificate is required, it will show this address." (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-143; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-057)

The other three germinal sections carry their hints word for word: Consignor "This is the sender of the consignment.", Consignee "This is the receiver or buyer of the consignment being shipped or transported." and Importer "This is usually the same as the consignee. You can select a different person if needed." (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122-m1)

Each germinal section with no address chosen shows its link — "Add a place of origin", "Add a consignor", "Add a consignee", "Add an importer", "Add a place of destination" — which opens the germinal set's own picker for that party; choosing an address there and saving returns to the germinal consignment addresses page, which shows that address's lines with a "Change" link, and the address is saved on that germinal products notification only. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, -p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-001, repo-frontend-p14-027)

Each germinal picker shows, on the full-width page column, the caption "Addresses", a "Search" field hinted "Name, address or country" with a "Search" button, the results heading "Select an address", a count reading "Showing 2 out of 2 results" for two results, a table with the columns "Name", "Address" and "Country", a "View" link on each row, "Previous" and "Next" pagination, and "No addresses match your search." when a search matches nothing; and it lists only the addresses the address book holds for that party's role. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013, -p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-002-m1)

The germinal consignment addresses page shows "Same as place of origin" on an empty Consignor section once a place of origin has been chosen, and "Same as consignee" on an empty Importer section and an empty Place of destination section once a consignee has been chosen; pressing one copies that party's address into the section. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p14-001)

Each germinal section holding an address shows a "Remove" button, styled as a link, beside its "Change" link, named to a screen reader "Remove place of origin", "Remove consignor", "Remove consignee", "Remove importer" or "Remove place of destination"; pressing it, with or without JavaScript, shows the germinal consignment addresses page again with that section's add link back and every other section's address kept. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-145, -p8-146, -p8-147; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-015)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the fifth section heading reads '5. Addresses' and that section holds one task, titled 'Consignment addresses'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-034; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-009, -p1-010, -p1-012, -p1-015; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-016, repo-frontend-p5-031; c-405)

The 'Consignment addresses' task on a germinal products notification's overview shows the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination' under its link. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-035; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-016; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-152; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-032)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Consignment addresses' task reads 'Complete' once all five consignment addresses are given, and 'To do' while any of them is missing. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-053)

In Welsh, the germinal consignment addresses page and its five pickers show every section title, hint, link, button and picker label in Welsh, and both the page and the pickers have no serious or critical accessibility violations. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-058)

rows.notes: Re-distil of the existing germinal consignment addresses row, which already combines three areas' drafts: this area's germinal page and five pickers (req-1826, req-1827), the cph-permanent-and-contact area's five-addresses-only rule (req-1832, req-1833) and the notification-hub area's germinal overview task (req-1840). This area's draft adds the two germinal hint requirements (req-2720, req-2721), which split off the germinal half of the place of origin and place of destination hints: building them apart would copy the same page twice. The germinal hints replace the earlier criterion that kept the live-animal wording for every hint; req-1827 now says the copy differs from its live twin only in the two missing sections and these two hints, so the three other hints stay word for word. Because the copy behaves as the live page and pickers do, it carries the Remove buttons on party sections and the full-width pickers that the consignment-parties branch builds on the live twin; those criteria are stated here for the germinal copy only, and the live requirements stay with that branch. c-091: the prototype wins on what germinal products are asked (no county parish holding number) and ruling sam-2026-10-09 makes germinal products their own set, so the live-animals set keeps exempting only 0101 and 01061900. c-405: the owner's 17 November decision ranks above the prototype, so the overview section reads '5. Addresses' and its task 'Consignment addresses'; the task covers the five addresses only, as the germinal set holds no county parish holding number and no permanent address. Each germinal page is copied after its live twin is built, and the germinal-products theme already lands after the consignment-parties and identification-and-permanent-address themes, so the order holds through the themes. The behaviour is the same in stub mode and on the compose stack. Re-distil against the 26 November prototype: the germinal claims behind this row are unchanged, so the row stands as it was.
